title: 第十七章 我是王府李管家我乃求追读第十八章 愧疚加更求追读
lines: 深夜。
平安巷的一座院落，清水帮的新驻地。
“帮主，这地方待着真憋屈，连个姑娘都没有。”
“副帮主，要姑娘还不简单，咱们白天走的这几条巷子，其中有几家的姑娘长得可是不错，要不现在去敲门？”
曹鹏听着手下的话，将酒碗往桌子一拍：“现在什么时候了，还想着裤裆里那点屁事。”
见到帮主突然发怒，这几位清水帮的核心帮众面面相觑露出讪笑。
“眼下关键是要把‘平安钱’给收上来，要是收不齐，东家发怒后果你们是知道的。”
身为一次磨皮武者，曹鹏能够拉起这支队伍，在城西那等鱼龙混杂之地曾占下几条街面，除了自身狠辣，更是因为背后有东家撑腰。
可即便是他背后的东家，也没法跟四海帮相比，四海帮扩张极快，手段狠辣，他原先的地盘被挤压得难以生存，硬扛只有死路一条，东家也保不住他，无奈之下，只得带着这十几号兄弟，灰溜溜地转战到这城北一带。
至于投靠四海帮？
他不敢。
东家是对付不了四海帮，但要捏死他曹鹏，却跟捏死只蚂蚁差不多。
没有东家，他曹鹏连一次磨皮都做不到，可也因为东家，自从他一次磨皮后，便被东家派来组建帮派，赚取的钱财九成都上供给了东家，这也导致他后续根本没怎么练武。
“都给我听清楚了”曹鹏环视手下，目光阴沉，“这这条街巷住的人不少，油水是有的，但咱们初来乍到，脚跟没站稳。”
他顿了顿，指着桌上粗糙的巷道草图：“先按老规矩，挨家挨户去‘知会’，没钱的可以少收点，要的是他们认下平安钱这个规矩，习惯每月交这笔钱。”
干了几年帮派，曹鹏太清楚底层老百姓了，刚开始可以收的不多，只要老百姓接受了，日后再加码，也不敢再反抗。
他灌了口酒，语气放缓了些，却带着更深的寒意：“等这条巷子，还有旁边那几条巷子的人，都习惯了每月给咱们上供，认了咱们清水帮是这里的‘话事人’，到时候……”
他没说完，但在场的人都听懂了潜台词。
到时候，想怎么样，还不是他们说了算？
看上的姑娘，瞧上的铺面，总有办法弄到手。
“帮主英明。”
“还是帮主厉害。”
边上几人纷纷开口奉承，酒过三巡，便是有人尿意上来，起身朝着门外走去。
“麻子怎么这么久还没回来，不会掉进茅坑中了吧，帮主我去看看。”
屋子里，另外一位满脸通红的汉子站起身，然而走到门口的刹那，冷风袭来，当看到站在面前的身影，酒意瞬间醒了大半。
他刚要张口示警，可嘴里还未吐出字，一只拳头便在他眼前急速放大，裹挟着凌厉的破空声，重重轰在了他面门正中！
闷响如击败革。
壮汉连惨叫都没能发出，鼻梁骨瞬间塌陷粉碎，整个人被巨力打得离地倒飞，狠狠撞在还未完全打开的门板上，将门板“哐当”一声撞得向内敞开，身体软软瘫倒在地，七窍流血。
“找死！”曹鹏又惊又怒，他是磨皮一次的武者，反应最快，一把掀翻桌子挡在身前，同时厉喝道：“抄家伙！”
剩下那名男子听后，慌忙去抓靠在墙边的砍刀。
但冲进来的身影速度更快，根本不理会被掀飞的桌子，脚下步伐诡异一错，避开飞溅的碗碟酒水，人已如鬼魅般贴近那名抓刀的男子。
男子刀刚入手，还未举起，蒙面人的左手已然扣住他持刀的手腕，用力一捏一拧！
“咔嚓！”
腕骨断裂的脆响清晰可闻。
content_en:
late at night.
A courtyard in Ping'an Lane, the new residence of the Qingshui Gang.
"Gang Leader, it's so frustrating to live in this place. There aren't even any girls."
"Deputy gang leader, it's not easy to find a girl. There are some pretty girls in some of the alleys we walked during the day. Why don't you knock on the door now?"
Cao Peng listened to his men and slapped the wine bowl on the table: "What time is it now? I'm still thinking about that shit in my crotch."
Seeing the gang leader's sudden anger, the core members of the Qingshui Gang looked at each other and laughed.
"The key now is to collect the 'safety money'. If you don't collect it all, you know the consequences of the boss's anger."
As a skin-sharpening warrior, Cao Peng was able to pull up this team and once occupied several streets in a mixed-race place like the west of the city. In addition to being ruthless, Cao Peng also had the support of his boss behind him.
But even the boss behind him couldn't compare with the Sihai Gang. The Sihai Gang expanded very quickly and used ruthless methods. His original territory was squeezed to the point where it was difficult to survive. He would only die if he fought hard. The boss couldn't save him. In desperation, he had no choice but to take these dozen brothers and move to the north of the city in despair.
As for joining the Sihai Gang?
He didn't dare.
The boss can't deal with the Sihai Gang, but squeezing Cao Peng to death is almost like squeezing an ant to death.
Without his boss, he, Cao Peng, couldn't even do one skin resurfacing, but because of his boss, he was sent by his boss to form a gang after his first skin resurfacing, and 90% of the money he earned was provided to his boss, which also led to him not practicing martial arts at all.
"Listen to me clearly." Cao Peng looked around his men with gloomy eyes, "There are many people living in this street and there is plenty of money and water, but we are new here and have not yet established our feet."
He paused and pointed to the rough sketch of the lane on the table: "First follow the old rules and go door to door to 'notify' us. Those who don't have money can charge less. What we need is that they recognize the rules of peace money and get used to paying this money every month."
After working in a gang for several years, Cao Peng knew the people at the bottom very well. He could not accept much at the beginning. As long as the people accepted it, he would not dare to resist if he added more money in the future.
He took a sip of wine and his tone became slower, but with a deeper chill: "When the people in this alley and the adjacent alleys become accustomed to paying us monthly tributes and recognize our Qingshui Gang as the 'talkers' here, then..."
He didn't finish his sentence, but everyone present understood the subtext.
When the time comes, it’s not up to them to decide what they want to do?
There is always a way to get the girl you like and the shop you like.
"The gang leader is wise."
"The gang leader is still awesome."
Several people around him began to flatter him. After three rounds of drinking, someone felt the urge to urinate, got up and walked towards the door.
"Why hasn't Mazi come back for so long? He didn't fall into the pit, right? Let me go take a look, helper."
In the room, another man with a red face stood up. However, the moment he walked to the door, a cold wind hit him. When he saw the figure standing in front of him, he almost woke up from the drunkenness.
He was about to open his mouth to warn, but before he could utter a word, a fist quickly enlarged in front of his eyes, followed by a sharp sound of breaking through the air, and hit him hard in the middle of the door!
"Bang!"
Muffled sound like beaten leather.
The strong man couldn't even scream. The bridge of his nose instantly collapsed and shattered. He was knocked off the ground by the huge force and hit the door panel that had not been fully opened. The door panel opened inwards with a clang. His body fell limply to the ground, bleeding from all his orifices.
"Seeking death!" Cao Peng was shocked and angry. He was a warrior who had skinned his skin once. He had the fastest reaction. He overturned the table and blocked it in front of him. At the same time, he shouted: "Copycat!"
After hearing this, the remaining man hurriedly grabbed the machete leaning against the wall.
But the figure who rushed in was faster. He didn't pay attention to the table that was thrown away. He made a strange mistake in his steps and avoided the splashing dishes and drinks. He was already close to the man grabbing the knife like a ghost.
As soon as the man took the knife, before he even raised it, the masked man's left hand had already grabbed the wrist holding the knife, and squeezed and twisted it hard!
"Crack!"
The crisp sound of the wrist bone breaking was clearly audible.
"ah!"
